episodes.title: Il lago nero
episodes.summary: Still haunted by the tragedy that forced her to flee, Anna takes her teenage twins to her chilling family seat. The reception is far from friendly.

episodes.title: Il giorno successivo
episodes.summary: A secret's out as Thomas ventures into the darkness to find Anna. Daria gets a peek into Micki's family life, and Mauro digs into Curon's mysteries.

episodes.title: L'assassino
episodes.summary: A love affair echoes across generations while babes in the woods stumble upon secrets and face Thomas. Lukas discovers that he can't run from himself.

episodes.title: I padri
episodes.summary: A suspect is in custody, with questions left hanging. Thomas chooses transparency as a father surfaces, besties quarrel, and the timid lash out.

episodes.title: La maledizione
episodes.summary: Two families try to pick up the pieces. Yet the shadow of doubt remains, and a predator stalks Micki. Are happy endings possible in this deadly place?

episodes.title: I lupi
episodes.summary: A feeling of foreboding sweeps through Curon. The twins spring a trap. Klara warns Albert. Micki and Giulio prepare for the worst.

episodes.title: Il labirinto
episodes.summary: The Rainas and Aspers converge, but bad blood lingers. Will they get lost in a maze — and their emotions? Or will they recognize the truth?
